verdict.rationale: Canonical's Ubuntu Desktop page explicitly offers 'the power of a full Ubuntu terminal environment on Windows with Windows Subsystem for Linux' for web development, AI/ML tooling, and cross-platform development without leaving Windows. That directly matches running a full Linux terminal inside another host OS. Missing for 10: in-depth setup/usage documentation for Ubuntu on WSL, coverage of hosts other than Windows, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as claimed.
